How it started
Our story so far
Cast AI started out of personal frustration. After our previous startup, Zenedge was acquired by Oracle in 2018, we couldn’t stop thinking about the massive growth of our cloud bill. 
We kept asking ourselves, “Isn’t there a way to solve this problem once and for all?” That question became our mission.
So, built a platform that would optimize cloud infrastructure and reduce costs, without any manual intervention. That’s how Cast AI came to be: a solution built for every cloud-native company to effortlessly scale performance.
Leon, Laurent, and Yuri
Co-Founders of Cast
Who we are
Cast AI is “automation done right” – an APA® (Application Performance Automation) platform that balances the speed and efficiency of automation with a knowledgeable, developer-friendly team.

Values
Our core values
We apply our foundational values in every aspect of our work – from hiring to decision-making, execution, and feedback. These principles unite our teams, fuel fearless innovation, and drive real change in the cloud industry.
Expect and advocate change
Strive to innovate and accept the inevitable change that comes with innovation. Constantly welcome new ideas and opinions. Share insights responsibly with unwavering openness, honesty, and respect. Once a path is chosen, be ready to disagree and commit to a direction.
Lead
Take ownership and lead through action. Think and act on behalf of the entire company to build long-term value across team boundaries.
Develop and hire the best
Strive to raise the performance bar by continuously investing in yourself, the team and by hiring the best possible candidates for every position. Drive towards personal development and professional growth, and mentor others to raise the collective bar.
Practice customer obsession
Focus on the customer journey and work backwards. Strive to deliver customer value and continuously solve customer problems. Listen to customer feedback, act, and iterate to improve customer experience.
